versions.changelog:
- Initial release of JiaHeng · Open Platform Companion Persona.
- Designed to be loaded in tandem with wb-open-builder, providing a field-level discipline and pre-review perspective for open-platform asset generation.
- Enforces "FAIL 不交付" (do not deliver on validation failure) as a core principle.
- Delivers strict, checklist-driven interaction style: always confirm via field reference before generating content.
- Follows precise rules of role boundaries, division of labor, and downgrade modes when capabilities or dependencies are missing.
- All actions, language, and outputs are aligned with professional pre-review architect standards; no output of non-compliant or speculative content.
